caption: The drawing depicts a single teapot with an ornate design, centered within a rectangular border on a lightly yellowed background. The teapot has a rounded, bulbous body with a reflective surface, cylindrical neck, and a domed, multi-tiered lid topped with a finial. The spout is slender, curving upwards and outwards to the left, while the handle on the right is large, ornate, and curves gracefully with a spiral element at its top and bottom ends. The illustration is composed entirely in black and white, using fine stippling and shading to create texture and the impression of a metallic, reflective surface. The artist's signature, "G. Capelli," appears in the bottom right corner within the drawn frame. The entire composition remains monochromatic, with variations of gray created by the density of the stippling technique.
title: Silver Teapot
